about: Small good moments the page plays when something good happens: a tour you finished, the work your AIs got done, a phrase you typed. parts/delight-moments plays them; this file is all of them. A screen says what happened with sayHappened({ event_kind, ... }) (parts/ui/show/happened); a moment row answers an event by its kind (on.event_kind), optionally only when its fields match (on.match), only once ever (once), only at certain counts (count_at), or when a phrase is typed anywhere (on.typed). Each moment shows one line of words with a motion from motions, never a sound. scripts/check-delight.mjs refuses a commit that says an event no moment answers, unless the event is listed in quiet_events with why. records/copy-rules.json judges every line here. Adding a moment, a motion or an easter egg is a row here.

quiet_events.why: The error already appears where the work failed; a celebration would confuse it.
The shared button shows completion on each press; a separate moment on every press would interrupt the task.

The sent message is already visible in the conversation.

The notice itself is the visible moment, including error notices.
